name: 0.12mm Gloss Top Clear @Solder
notes: Glossy-top variant of 0.12mm Clear @Solder, and a deliberate trade against clarity. 0.12mm Clear @Solder sets top_shell_layers 0 because a solid top runs at its own angle and every crossing scatters. That also leaves nothing for the iron to flatten, so a glossy flat top face is impossible on it. This preset puts 3 top shells back and irons them: ironing_type top surfaces, flow 12%, spacing 0.15, speed 15. The result is a flat top face that reads as gloss and a part that is measurably less clear through the top than the pure clear preset. Take it only when the top face is the face being looked at. Ironing touches flat top surfaces only - it does nothing for walls, slopes or domes, and nothing for the bottom face, which takes its finish from the build plate and not from any slicer setting. Pair with Numakers PETG-HS Clear @Solder. The same preconditions apply: E_CAL_START / E_CAL_RESULT before trusting flow, and a dry spool.
